plan.title: Independent Validation Plan for CR-003

checks.title: AUC on Test Set
checks.rationale: AUC indicates the model's ability to discriminate between approved and declined applications.

checks.title: AUC on Out-of-Time Sample
checks.rationale: AUC on OOT sample assesses model stability over time.

checks.title: Brier Score
checks.rationale: Lower Brier scores indicate better calibration of predicted probabilities.

checks.title: Population Stability Index (PSI)
checks.rationale: PSI measures changes in the distribution of scores over time.

checks.title: Disparate Impact Ratio
checks.rationale: Ensures that the model does not disproportionately favor or disadvantage any group.

checks.title: Missing Any Rate
checks.rationale: High missing rates can indicate data quality issues affecting model performance.

checks.title: Share of Adverse Decisions
checks.rationale: Monitors the rate of adverse decisions to ensure compliance with policy limits.

checks.title: Monotonicity Check
checks.rationale: Ensures that credit limits do not increase as PD increases.

plan.rationale: This validation plan covers key performance, calibration, stability, fairness, data quality, and policy checks relevant to the CR-003 model. The thresholds are set based on industry standards to ensure the model's reliability and compliance.

data.summary: The validation plan for CR-003 includes a comprehensive set of checks focusing on performance, calibration, stability, fairness, data quality, and policy adherence. Each check is designed to ensure the model operates effectively within defined thresholds, promoting responsible credit limit assignment.
